# Core tools

<!-- GENERATED by mcp-server/scripts/generate_skill_reference.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Tools every deployment has. **write** tools exist only when the server runs with
`MCP_WRITES_ENABLED`; **approval** tools additionally need the project and the
organisation to enable AI approval. Parameters marked `*` are required. Omit
`organization_id` / `project_id` when the connection sets default-scope headers.
Module-contributed tools are in `module-tools.md`.

## `approve_requirement` (approval)

Approves a draft or reviewed requirement (the same transition the UI's "Approve" button performs).

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `requirement_id*` (string)

## `complete_requirement` (approval)

Marks an approved requirement completed (the same transition the UI's "Mark completed" action performs).

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `requirement_id*` (string)

## `create_artefact_link` (write)

Links an artefact to another record of the same project.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `artefact_type*` (string), `artefact_id*` (string), `link_type_id*` (string), `direction*` (string), `other_type*` (string), `other_id*` (string)

## `create_requirement` (write)

Creates a new requirement. Always starts in "draft" status — there is no way to create one pre-approved, and no tool here can approve it afterward either; use the ReqTrackManager UI for that.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `name*` (string), `component_id*` (string), `category_id*` (string), `reasoning` (string), `clarification` (string), `description` (string), `owner_id` (string), `target_stage_id` (string), `level` (string), `keywords` (list[string]), `custom_fields` (object), `review_date` (string), `review_lead_days` (integer), `reviewer_id` (string)

## `decide_change_request` (approval)

Approves or rejects a submitted (or in-review) change request.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `change_request_id*` (string), `approve*` (boolean), `note` (string)

## `delete_artefact_link` (write)

Removes a link touching an artefact. Irreversible: confirm with the user first.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `artefact_type*` (string), `artefact_id*` (string), `link_id*` (string)

## `get_artefact_link_graph` (read)

Gets what an artefact is linked to, out to a few hops: use it for impact analysis ("what depends on this?", "where does this come from?").

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `artefact_type*` (string), `artefact_id*` (string), `depth` (integer), `direction` (string)

## `get_change_request` (read)

Gets a single change request's full current detail.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `change_request_id*` (string)

## `get_custom_role` (read)

Gets a single custom role's own definition — same grant-roster exclusion as `list_custom_roles`.

Parameters: `organization_id` (string), `role_id*` (string)

## `get_project` (read)

Gets a single project's details by id.

Parameters: `project_id` (string)

## `get_requirement` (read)

Gets a single requirement's full current detail.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `requirement_id*` (string)

## `get_requirement_history` (read)

Gets a requirement's full version history — every prior state it has been in.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `requirement_id*` (string)

## `list_artefact_link_types` (read)

Lists the link types usable from an artefact, and what can sit at the other end: use before `create_artefact_link`.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `artefact_type*` (string), `artefact_id*` (string), `other_type` (string)

## `list_change_request_comments` (read)

Lists the discussion thread on a change request.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `change_request_id*` (string)

## `list_change_request_tasks` (read)

Lists the follow-up tasks tracked against a change request (C-R-02, C-R-04).

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `change_request_id*` (string)

## `list_change_request_votes` (read)

Gets a change request's advisory stakeholder vote tally and individual votes.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `change_request_id*` (string)

## `list_change_requests` (read)

Lists change requests in a project.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `status` (string)

## `list_custom_roles` (read)

Lists an organisation's custom roles (Fine-Grained Access Control) — each role's own definition (name, description, scope, permission-atom set) only, never who currently holds it.

Parameters: `organization_id` (string)

## `list_my_reviews_due` (read)

Lists requirements assigned to the caller with a scheduled review date that has now passed, across every project they have access to.

## `list_notifications` (read)

Lists the caller's own in-app notifications (project joins, stage transitions, change-request activity, permission grants, and more).

Parameters: `unread_only` (boolean)

## `list_organizations` (read)

Lists the organisations the caller's ReqTrackManager account belongs to or administers.

## `list_permissions` (read)

Lists an organisation's full, currently-valid Fine-Grained Access Control permission-atom vocabulary — every registered artefact type crossed with View/Propose-Create/Manage/Approve-Baseline (plus any registered sub-type for that artefact type), and the fixed administrative permissions (e.g. grant_roles). Describes what permissions *exist* to grant, not who currently holds them — see `list_custom_roles`/`get_custom_role` for role definitions built from this vocabulary.

Parameters: `organization_id` (string)

## `list_project_reviews_due` (read)

Lists every requirement in a project with a scheduled review date that has now passed, regardless of which reviewer it's assigned to.

Parameters: `project_id` (string)

## `list_projects` (read)

Lists projects the caller's ReqTrackManager account has a role on, across every organisation.

Parameters: `organization_id` (string), `search` (string), `include_archived` (boolean)

## `list_requirement_comments` (read)

Lists the discussion thread on a requirement.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `requirement_id*` (string)

## `list_requirements` (read)

Lists requirements in a project, with the same filters the Requirements page's filter panel offers.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `status` (string), `search` (string), `keyword` (string), `component_id` (string), `category_id` (string), `include_archived` (boolean)

## `update_requirement` (write)

Edits an unlocked requirement's content in place.

Parameters: `project_id` (string), `requirement_id*` (string), `name` (string), `reasoning` (string), `clarification` (string), `description` (string), `component_id` (string), `category_id` (string), `owner_id` (string), `target_stage_id` (string), `level` (string), `keywords` (list[string]), `custom_fields` (object), `review_date` (string), `review_lead_days` (integer), `reviewer_id` (string), `change_note` (string)
